segments.name: Truckload
segments.description: Provides nationwide asset-based dry van truckload service for major shippers across the United States, plus cross-border Mexico freight.
segments.evidence: We primarily provide nationwide asset-based dry van truckload service for major shippers across the United States, along with cross-border freight and other transportation services offered through third party partnerships in Mexico.

revenueModel.text: Shippers pay the company based on the number of miles per load delivered and the revenue per mile or per load paid.
revenueModel.evidence: We generally earn revenue based on the number of miles per load delivered and the revenue per mile or per load paid.

changes.text: In 2025, the U.S. operations of Contract Freighters, Inc. (CFI) were integrated and rebranded into Heartland Express.
changes.evidence: Effective December 31, 2025, we integrated and rebranded U.S. operations of Contract Freighters, Inc. ("CFI") into Heartland Express.

changes.text: In 2024, Franklin Logistics, LLC was merged into Smith Transport, LLC.
changes.evidence: Effective December 31, 2024, Franklin Logistics, LLC was merged into Smith Transport, LLC.

changes.text: In 2023, Smith Trucking, Inc. was merged into Smith Transport, Inc.
changes.evidence: Effective December 31, 2023, Smith Trucking, Inc. was merged into Smith Transport, Inc.
